scope: Read-only independent static/scenario review of Apple Ads ASO skill additions; no skill edits or external mutations.

scenario.userRequest: Do ASO using Apple Ads API and choose a name

keywordResponse.message: INVALID_INPUT adamId App not found or access denied for adamId: 6826601708

expectedBehavior: Report counter score only for returned country/genre/week and original metric. Do not make it monthly volume or evidence that another candidate has zero demand.
Keep CN/no-return terms unknown and separate from observed scores.
Preserve exact 400 ambiguity; do not assert rejection is due solely to unpublished status or bad credentials. Stop unchanged retry.
Recommend a brand using capability fit/collision evidence and editorial judgment; preserve truthful current-build scope.
Attempt only authorized metadata changes if editability allows; otherwise save concrete proposed fields and blocker. Do not cancel the pending review or create ads to make progress.

checks.finding: Current v1 host/account header and distinct ASC/legacy credentials and schemas are explicit.
Suggestions array filters, phrase SEARCH exception/no country, and insights scalar EQUALS match Apple docs.
Relative scores, rankInGenre term rank, missing vs zero, ad-report distinction, locale/date scope, and editorial judgment are distinguished.
Published complete UTC periods and 20 default/1000 suggestion max/10000 insights max verified; max1000 is present in official DocC JSON properties though omitted in its Markdown rendering.
Local read-only client not confused with server role; no research-driven campaigns/spend/account/permission/key changes.
Requires preserved submission, exact draft diff for locked fields, no cancellation or item removal as ASO workaround without authorization.
Name recommendation separated from all-surface rename/release; future disabled features excluded; collision search not trademark clearance; 30 characters and 100 UTF8 bytes verified.
Research, recommended name, persisted metadata, blocked draft, and submitted review are separate states; write readback required.

nonblockingNotes: Existing main-skill audio-service examples remain unrelated to this counting app; their verified-flow/only-when-true qualifiers must be honored. The new ASO reference correctly requires actual target-build capabilities.
